Tender Notice No. 38 of 2020–21 – Point-wise Details
Tender Notice No.: 38 of 2020–21.
Department: Government of Gujarat, Narmada Water Resources, Water Supply & Kalpasar Department.
Inviting Authority: Executive Engineer, Ukai Division No. 1, Ukai.
Mode of Tendering: Online (E-Tender).
Name of Works: Seven civil and electro-mechanical works at Ukai Dam as detailed below.
Details of Works
Construction of new 3.75 m wide concrete Trimix roads, strengthening of existing 6.70 m and 3.75 m asphalt roads, profile correction with 30 mm thick SDBC, culverts and minor bridges at Ukai Dam.
Estimated Cost: 11,51,66,390.81.
Providing and installation of Dam Top Lighting and other electrification works at Ukai Dam.
Estimated Cost: 6,50,50,317.20.
Providing and installation of CCTV Surveillance System, Fire Safety Arrangements, Boom Barrier and related works including Operation & Maintenance (O&M) at Ukai Dam.
Estimated Cost: 23,75,36,70.40.
Providing and installation of SCADA-based Gate Operation, ARMC & Monitoring Control System, Instrumentation and other related works including Operation & Maintenance (O&M) at Ukai Dam.
Estimated Cost: 12,89,28,983.00.
Turfing work for D/S slope of Earthen Dam portion at Ukai Dam.
Estimated Cost: 7,33,61,833.48.
Renovation works of VIP Rest House at Ukai Dam Site.
Estimated Cost: 3,71,63,912.45.
Protection work to damaged portion near the Right Training (RT) wall of the diversion channel of Ukai Dam.
Estimated Cost: 2,49,50,765.83.
Tender Schedule
Online Tender Submission Period: 25/01/2021 to 24/02/2021 up to 16:00 hrs.
Last Date for Submission of Physical Documents: 25/02/2021 to 05/03/2021 up to 18:00 hrs.
Office Details
Office: Executive Engineer, Ukai Division No. 1, Ukai.
Address: Fort Songadh, District Tapi – 394680.
